title: Mail
intro: The server scheduled tasks use to send emails. It is saved only on this computer, because the tasks run here. The password goes to the system keychain.
noneWarning: Unencrypted, the user, the password and the emails travel readable over the network. Use it only with a server on your local network.
userPlaceholder: Empty if the server doesn't require signing in
passwordHelp: If you leave the password empty, the saved one is kept. Without a user, none is saved.
notConfigured: No server has been saved yet.
testPrompt: Which address should we send it to?
